page.overview:
Who is Mrs. Jackson?

Mrs. Jackson is an African American citizen residing in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles Los Angeles], [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/California California]. She is a regular customer of the Ito Family convenience store as well as a longtime friend of the family as she recognized G.I. Joe member MacArthur "Quick Kick" Ito from when he was a little boy. While waiting for her bag of groceries, she listened to Mrs. Ito express her happiness over her son spending his vacation time working at the store. Mrs. Jackson was the last customer to leave the store after Quick Kick abruptly departed to answer an emergency G.I. Joe signal. Immediately after Mrs. Jackson left the store, Tomax and Xamot and a squad of Crimson Guards entered the store and abducted the Itos..
